detail.longDescription: 🤖 AI coding agents can be hijacked by a malicious AGENTS.md placed in a Downloads folder. Researchers showed an agent reading it as instructions and installing a rogue npm package — prompt injection through files it scans, not the chat prompt. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/ai-coding-agents-hijacked-using-agentsmd-file-in-downloads-folder/ # AIAgents # PromptInjection # InfoSec
